title: What shaped Visigothic Kingdom?
question: What shaped Visigothic Kingdom?
claim: Wikidata lists 3 parts or significant events of Visigothic Kingdom among TIMEWISE's records; these 3 are the best documented, in date order.
why: Each record after the first is linked to Visigothic Kingdom by a Wikidata statement (part of, or significant event), and they are told in date order.

records.description: Period of Germanic rule on the Iberian Peninsula (418–720) as a successor state to the Western Roman Empire.
(418-507) first period of the Visigothic Kingdom with capital in Tolosa
549-711 second period of the Visigothic Kingdom with capital in Toledo
711 battle between the Visigothic Kingdom and the Umayyad Caliphate; decisive Umayyad victory leads to the fall of the Visigothic Kingdom and the Umayyad conquest of the peninsula
